facts.text: Grimny's ghost believes his greedy brother Bral killed him, and Grimny's body lay under the natural-looking cave-in sealing the Dwarven mine. Did Bral really kill Grimny, and did he cause the cave-in?
What became of Grimny's other brothers, Grelli, Durney, Brenny, Tedry and Rooney, who worked the Dwarven mine with him?
